title: aster phlogifolius var. patens
intro: Aster phlogifolius var. patens, commonly known as Mexican Marigold or Mexican Tarragon, is a shrubby perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Mexican Marigold include its ability to calm the digestive system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
